Name: Bounding Polygon
Description: This optional extension provides an accurate location of the significant data contained in the Image Segment. The coordinates of this bounding polygon refer to the absolute coordinate system defined in the GEOPS (and possibly in the PRJPS) extension.

NUM_PTS.Name: Number of Points in the Bounding Polygon
NUM_PTS.Description: This field shall contain the number of points (coordinate pairs) constituting the bounding polygon. Whenever possible, the first and last points should be the same in order to close the polygon (e.g., a rectangular region would report five points), although this is not a strict requirement. Coordinate values shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly in PRJPS).

LON_<NUM_PTS>.Name: Longitude or Easting
LON_<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Longitude (otherwise) of the nth bounding polygon point.

LAT_<NUM_PTS>.Name: Latitude or Northing
LAT_<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Latitude (otherwise) of the nth bounding polygon point.
